Create ONE original professional Android app icon for the Chinese personal finance brand 花有谱 (Hua You Pu). Brand meaning: spending money with clarity and a plan; 花 also means flower, 谱 means ordered record/rhythm. The visual symbol MUST unite a flower with an unmistakable ledger/receipt/accounting cue in one integrated clever mark, not two unrelated cliparts. Friendly, intelligent, everyday financial confidence. Refined flat vector-style bitmap, precise clean curves, strong negative space, very limited solid colors. A single unified central symbol occupies approximately 60 percent of the square width with generous empty safe area, suitable for circular Android icon masks. Full bleed opaque uniform background. Canvas 1024 by 1024 pixels. No typography, no letters, no Chinese characters, no words, no captions, no currency characters, no watermark, no phone mockup, no presentation board. No generic plant shop illustration, no animal, no shields, no decorative floating sparkles, no 3D render, no noisy texture, no drop shadow. Design for instant recognition at 48 pixels. Warm coral orange #EE7756 uniform background. Cream #FFF8ED central mark. Design a compact blooming flower made from THREE sturdy softly rounded receipt-paper petals fanning upward from one common base, central receipt petal tall, two side receipt petals slightly lower and rotated outward. Each petal has a subtle rounded clipped paper corner, and the central petal has TWO short thick horizontal ledger slits cut in coral. Together silhouette reads a charming three-petal flower at first glance and organized spending receipts at second glance. Short elegant stem with one small cream leaf integrated into common base, not a separate botanical drawing. Broad confident simple shapes, modern distinctive app emblem.
